data_description.temp_differential: How far below target temperature before requesting heat (e.g., 0.5°C means heat when 0.5° below target)
data_description.overheat_threshold: How far above target temperature before TRV turns off (e.g., 1.0°C means turn off when 1° above target)
data_description.min_cycle_time: Minimum time between zone thermostat on/off changes to prevent rapid cycling
data_description.window_delay: Wait time after window opens before pausing heating (prevents false triggers)
data_description.person_entities: People to track for away mode - when all are away, heating enters low power mode
data_description.away_temperature: Temperature to set all TRVs to when everyone is away (default: 16°C)
data_description.away_mode_delay: Wait time after everyone leaves before activating away mode - cancels if anyone returns (default: 10 minutes)
